'''SoapBox Analytics''' is the first-party, cookieless web-analytics surface of the [[SoapBox]] ecosystem, published at analytics.soapbox.community. It records aggregate traffic for the ecosystem's own sites without setting a tracking cookie or building a per-visitor profile.

== Function ==
Analytics is served by the ecosystem itself rather than by a third-party tracker, so page-view data is not shared with an outside advertising network. The dashboard that presents the aggregated figures is access-restricted (it returns an authentication challenge to the public), because it is an operator tool rather than a public page; the measurement it performs is privacy-preserving by design.
